description: Asks for one care check on one site now, outside its schedule (get_care_status lists each program's checks and whether it runs at the site's level). It is queued and runs within the hour, unless the site's plan does not include the program (status not-in-plan, with includedIn naming the plans that would; nothing is queued); one waits per check at a time, and a site may ask a few times a day (the answer says when it may ask again). Read the result with list_care_activity and get_care_status. It never changes the site.

check_kind.description: The check (get_care_status lists each program's checks).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: run_care_check
title: Run a care check now
